market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from oil-driven inflation fears and Middle East escalation. Dow's 400-point slide signals risk-off. CPI data this week is critical: if oil passes through to headline CPI, Fed may hold or hike, pressuring equities. Energy and defense outperform; growth and consumer lag. Volatility elevated through geopolitical resolution.
market_outlook.long_term: AI/AGI cycle provides structural growth tailwind (OpenAI, AMD, Arm, China AI expansion). U.S. fiscal trajectory ($40T debt) is a medium-term overhang. De-dollarization is gradual, not abrupt. Energy transition and nuclear (HGP SPAC, Argentina RA-10) offer 5-10 year themes. Consumer weakness may persist through 2027.
